retraction.reason: Retracted in M40b: the convention on the rights of the child, adopted in November 1989 and the most widely ratified treaty there is. As with CEDAW, its lineage is not in this atlas. That lineage is the declaration of 1959 and the drafting group of the 1980s. Its Portuguese reach would be legislation on children, the family and schooling, and no record here holds any of it. M40b kept the covenant of 1966 because it is the direct binding successor of the Charter this atlas does hold.
